subsetOf: records/action-registry.json; not a second level policy registry
target: native issued own-window/object refs; no arbitrary path, Intent action/component, package or URI supplied in these actions

actions.completion: PlatformFlowReceipt: system handler started or typed unavailable/waiting; always open the system-recommended default-apps page even when already role holder, never report default changed on startActivity
actions.returnPrivacy: own role held yes/no/unknown may be observed separately; do not return identity of another default browser
actions.retry: same requestId with fresh proof returns existing flow, not relaunch; another explicit open uses new requestId

actions.completion: PlatformFlowReceipt for own-application system page; displayed page is not OS permission granted, onResume alone is not consent/result
actions.retry: return existing flow for same request; no opening other applications' settings

conditions: no sourceRef means app-owned OS picker stage, not current page/download guessing
sourceRef resolves to exact native owned staging/input offer with actual URI read grant, never caller asserted filesystem access
actions.completion: bounded source/copy/validation then exact system installer HANDOFF_STARTED; not installed/owner consent, failure/return without a trustworthy receipt remains unknown
actions.cancel: close own pending InputStream/request actual worker cancellation before releasing copy slot; user leaving OS installer is not proof a submitted installation did not occur
actions.retry: fresh proof/same request returns same job/source stage; no automatic second installer launch after timeout

actions.completion: one own-window layer consumed or explicit no-op/waiting; revision changes once; never injected global Android BACK against other software/system dialogs
actions.sourceProtection: may cancel/leave an owned source-warning flow; never simulates positive trust/force-use/owner-auth clicks
actions.retry: same request returns previous consumed layer; new request with old presentation revision is rejected, not another back

flowOwnership.actualBudget: one in-flight actual platform handoff per own window; caller timeout/Activity pause does not make slot free
flowOwnership.foreground: resolve exact own live window, awake/unlocked/actual foreground as needed; WAIT_FOREGROUND instead of waking/unlocking or launching over unrelated software
flowOwnership.dispatch: current source/data gate and unified authority first; fixed system-handler validation not caller-package whitelist
flowOwnership.systemBoundary: Android mandatory grants/installer/default choice remain OS/owner decisions, not hidden app authority vetoes
flowOwnership.reconstruction: journal flow identity/stage; on return/recreate resolve actual state, never assume success/cancel or replay launch

coverageBoundary: four actions only; 178 policy entries do not imply 178 concrete DTO contracts or handlers complete
